result.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
result.amount: ₹50,000/- per annum for every year of study (maximum of 4 years for first-year admitted students and maximum of 3 years for lateral/diploma-entry students)
documents_required: HSC/12th certificate (In case of Degree level)
ITI/Diploma certificate (In case of Diploma level)
result.how_to_apply: Apply online via the National Scholarships Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with new registration and document uploads (including via DigiLocker).
result.notes: Scholarship benefits are for college fees, computer, books and software. Maximum 5,000 slots per annum. Limited to a maximum of two girl children per family. Available for students in AICTE-approved technical institutions. Special provisions for 13 Union Territories and North Eastern States. Application is free. Payment made via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
